description: A synthetic test subscription with every step (checkout, acknowledgment email, reminders at each legal window, cancellation, confirmation): what was observed, check results, evidence ids and fixes. While running, next_action.type is "wait" and waiting_for says what it waits for: pass wait: 55 to get the answer as soon as the run finishes (one or two calls per run). When finished, apply the fixes (usually via get_compliance_plan) and start another run to verify. Without test_run, returns the newest run of the site.

site.description: Site id (site_…). Optional when the account has exactly one site in this mode; list_sites shows them.

test_run.description: Test run id (run_…). Default: the newest run of the site.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the run to finish before answering (0-55; larger values wait 55). Answers at once when it finishes.

name: get_test_run
title: Get a test run (steps, observations, fixes)
